verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म सत्यं जगन्मिथ्या जीवो ब्रह्मैव नापरः ।
अनेन वेद्यं सच्छास्त्रम् इति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥
verses.translation: Brahman (the Absolute) is the truth, the world is illusion, the individual soul is Brahman itself and nothing else — this is the proclamation of Vedanta.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
verses.translation: He who worships Me as dwelling equally in all beings, having established himself in unity — that yogi, in all circumstances, abides in Me.
